steps.title: College Admin Authentication
steps.description: Academic administrator authenticates and opens the Course registration desk

steps.title: Verify Enrolment Desk Loaded
steps.description: College enrolment desk renders with term and handover sections

steps.title: Select Academic Term
steps.description: Registrar selects the 2026 ODD term so the registration window context is bound

steps.title: Enter Programme Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies the programme id for the eligibility validation enrolment

steps.title: Enter Application Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies a dedicated application id for this eligibility story

steps.title: Enter Student Identifier
steps.description: Staff supplies a dedicated student id to avoid term duplicate collisions

steps.title: Open Enrolment From Handover
steps.description: Open a PENDING enrolment that will be validated for eligibility

steps.title: Verify Handover Success Banner
steps.description: UI confirms the PENDING enrolment was persisted before eligibility validation

steps.title: Enrolment Appears In List
steps.description: PENDING enrolment for the demo student is listed on the registrar desk

steps.title: Validate Enrolment Eligibility
steps.description: Academic administrator runs eligibility validation on the new PENDING enrolment

steps.title: Eligibility Result Visible
steps.description: UI shows eligibility outcome panel after validation

steps.title: Confirm Eligible Outcome
steps.description: Result reports Eligible when the registration window is open

steps.title: PostgreSQL Eligibility Status Read-Back
steps.description: Read-only query verifies the enrolment advanced to ELIGIBLE under the pilot tenant
steps.query: SELECT id, status, application_id, student_id FROM stu.enrolments WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND application_id = 'c3030000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003' AND status = 'ELIGIBLE'

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: API Gateway blocks unauthenticated POST to enrolment eligibility with HTTP 401
